This example uses only freshly simulated observations. The model structure is
specified by the user; graph validation is not causal discovery. Its fixed rho
is a demonstration choice, not a tuned optimum.

```{r}
source(system.file("examples", "quick_start.R", package = "grsem"))
```

Only structural regressions enter the directed graph. Measurement loadings and
covariances do not. The refit is ML-only; ordinary p-values do not account for
the selection procedure.
